about: Every card face in the Lunar Base print files. One entry per distinct printed face; `count` is the number of copies and `sources` lists the print page of each copy. Read docs/current/rules.md section 9 for the meaning of the fields.
render: pdftoppm -r 300 -x 35 -y 35 -W 591 -H 1181 -png <pdf>; one PDF page is one card face

text_conventions.credit_glyph: The printed Credit sign (a coin with a crescent) is written as the character ¢.
text_conventions.boxes: Square brackets mark the printed outlined boxes; commas separate actions inside one box; a slash separates icon groups printed side by side without boxes.
text_conventions.printed_name: Upper case as printed, read top line first.

half_orb_slots.meaning: T top edge centre, RU right edge upper half, RL right edge lower half, B bottom edge centre, LL left edge lower half, LU left edge upper half. null means no half-orb is printed there.
